requirements.text: Customers should be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
The system should provide immediate confirmation to customers after booking an appointment.
The system should send reminders via text or email a day before and an hour before the appointment.
The system should prevent double bookings.
The system should allow the user to manage the schedule directly.
The system needs to be user-friendly and not complicate current operations.
The system must accommodate last-minute changes and maintain flexibility in scheduling.
The system might include reporting features to analyze appointment trends without disrupting the workflow.
